archetype: Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury / Archetype 2: Performance Pro Hybrid

design_philosophy.emotion: Absolute control, elite precision, and untouchable high-status. It should feel like stepping into a Mercedes S-Class or opening a Swiss private banking app.
rules: No rounded, friendly 'bubble' UI. Use sharp md (8px) to lg (12px) radii max.
No pure black or pure grey. Always tint backgrounds with deep obsidian/indigo for warmth.
Data is the decoration. Use typography scale and high-contrast numbers instead of unnecessary icons.
Use 'Bento' or 'Control Room' grid rules. Maximize space but leave elegant breathing room via generous padding within cards.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard. Prefer p-4 to p-6 inside cards. Gap-4 between lists.
layout_and_spacing.container_paddings: px-4 py-6 for main screen containers.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento style for Dashboard. Vertical dense lists for CRM records.

dashboard.title: Дашборд
components: Hero Metrics: Massive type (metric scale) for Total Revenue and Margin. Margin in #00E676.
Bento Cards: Side-by-side squares for 'Unpaid by Clients' and 'Owed to Carriers'.
Chart: Minimalist spline/bar chart (react-native-chart-kit/victory-native). No gridlines, just data curve.

orders.title: Заявки
components: Status Badges: Tiny, uppercase tracking-wide pills. (e.g., 'ОПЛАЧЕНО', 'В РАБОТЕ').
Margin Indicator: Right-aligned, monospace font, bright green if positive.

clients.title: Клиенты
components: Avatar: 2-letter monogram inside a circle with subtle #C0A062 tint background.
Data Row: Name in h3, INN (Tax ID) and Total Revenue in mono font below.

carriers.title: Перевозчики
components: Vehicle Tag: Small, sharp pill detailing vehicle type and capacity (e.g., 'Тент 20т 90м3').
Rating: Star icon (Phosphor/Lucide) with number, gold colored.

call_base.title: База для обзвона
components: Action Priority: Red/Orange indicators for overdue calls.
Swipe Actions: Right-swipe to mark as 'Called', left-swipe to 'Snooze/Schedule'.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C0A062] text-black rounded-lg py-4 px-6 items-center justify-center font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white rounded-lg py-4 px-6 items-center justify-center font-medium

badges.success: bg-[#00E676]/10 text-[#00E676] px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-bold
badges.pending: bg-[#F59E0B]/10 text-[#F59E0B] px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-bold
badges.danger: bg-[#FF3B30]/10 text-[#FF3B30] px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-bold

motion_and_interaction.buttons: Scale down to 0.98 on press (React Native Pressable/TouchableOpacity).
motion_and_interaction.modals: Bottom sheet pattern (Gorhom Bottom Sheet) for creating/editing records to keep context.

icons.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure lucide-react-native is installed. Use consistent stroke width of 1.5 for a delicate, premium look.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: No placeholder images needed. UI should rely purely on typography, layout, and lucide-react-native icons to maintain the abstract, high-end private banking feel.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text-to-background contrast ratio meets or exceeds WCAG AA standards. Softened whites (#A1A1AA) on deep blacks (#121215) hit the sweet spot for legibility without blooming.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST use testID (e.g., testID='create-order-button', testID='client-list-item-0'). This is critical for automated React Native testing.
